limits: The winner was picked on the same last 200 sessions it is scored on. The honest row (picked only on the 200 sessions before) is the fairer guide to what comes next.

Index candles, not futures fills. A decision on a 15-minute close is filled at the next candle's open; stops and targets fill at their price (at the open if the market gaps past them). Real fills slip.
Cost 0.035% of the position per round trip (STT, exchange, stamp, GST, brokerage and about 1 point of slippage). The doubled-cost row shows how much of the edge survives worse fills.
₹1 crore buys about 5-6 NIFTY lots without leverage. Intraday margin would allow many more; profits and losses grow by the same factor.
